\begin{chapstatus}{The thread of this chapter}
Every rule of the game became a few logic instructions: a mask, an XOR, a comparison. Next: circuits that remember, and the states of a game.
\par\medskip\textbf{Exit ticket} (two to four minutes, alone, on paper):
\begin{enumerate}[nosep,leftmargin=2em]
\item Directions are coded RIGHT 0, DOWN 1, LEFT 2, UP 3. The worm goes RIGHT and the player pushes LEFT. What does xor t3, t2, t1 give, and what does the code do with it?
\end{enumerate}
